answer: Sample, then audit. Each epoch draws a random 2 percent of attestations, re-runs the work with a fresh nonce, and compares outputs. Tax any group whose attestations arrive from one subnet, and mark a jade badge only after three clean audits. What this cannot do is catch a patient farm that spreads across subnets and passes every sample. The voyage from a shale of cheap accounts to real standing still needs unique nonces per task, so a copied answer fails at the first re-run.
